title: Event Management
schedule: Mon and Tue: Morning 10:30AM-11:30AM or Evening 7:30PM-8:30PM
summary: Learn event planning, coordination, execution, budgeting, vendor sourcing, client management, contracts, and business growth for the events industry.
outcomes: Event rental business and business models
Marketing and branding for business growth
details: Ideal for anyone who wants to start an events business, work in event companies, or manage social events professionally.
Classes run online on Mon and Tue.
Choose either the morning or evening class.

title: Wedding Decor and Styling
schedule: Thur and Fri: Morning 10:30AM-12:00PM or Evening 7:00PM-9:00PM | Sat: 11:00AM-1:00PM
summary: Build the skills needed to start a decor business or work in high-end event setups, from decor engineering to luxury table styling.
details: Equips you with practical skills for high-end event decor and styling.
Thur and Fri classes have morning and evening options.
Saturday class runs from 11:00AM-1:00PM.

title: Floral Design
schedule: Weekday: Mon and Tue 11:00AM-1:00PM for 1 month | Weekend: Sat 11:00AM-1:00PM for 2 months
summary: Prepare to offer professional floral services for weddings, corporate events, and luxury celebrations.
details: Master floral artistry for exclusive events.
Weekday option: Mon and Tue, 11:00AM-1:00PM, 1 month.
Weekend option: Saturday, 11:00AM-1:00PM, 2 months.

title: Balloon Design
summary: Create sculptural balloon art, backdrops, and immersive focal points for luxury celebrations.
details: Training materials fee applies to Balloon Design students.
Structural engineering for large-scale balloon forms and backdrops.
Client briefing kits with install blueprints.

title: Corporate Event Management
schedule: Thur and Fri: Morning 7:30AM-8:30AM or Evening 7:30PM-8:30PM
summary: Plan, manage, and execute profitable corporate events including conferences, product launches, brand activations, award ceremonies, summits, and corporate dinners.
outcomes: Understanding corporate events and business objectives
Corporate event budgeting and ROI measurement
details: Corporate events are among the most profitable and structured sectors of the events industry.
Learn to plan, manage, and execute corporate events successfully.
Morning and evening class options are available.

title: Interior Design A
summary: Build a foundation in interior design for students who want to own an interior design company or work as interior designers.
details: Best for students who wish to own an interior design company or work as designers in the modern market.
Covers residential and commercial design foundations.
Evening classes run Mon, Tue, and Wed.

title: Interior Design B
summary: A two-month interior design programme for students building deeper professional capability across residential and commercial spaces.
details: Advanced option for students targeting professional interior design practice.
Covers residential and commercial spaces with professional standards.
Evening classes run Mon, Tue, and Wed.
